programmes.d: A blackout causes a city's population to vanish. A handful of survivors realize they escape the darkness.
A group of misfits acquire a rare tape with terrifying footage and are confronted with a dead body.
Mysterious VHS tapes with horrific contents are found in a missing student's abandoned house.
Two teenage assassins accept what they think will be a quick-and-easy job, until an unexpected target throws them off their plan.

programmes.t: We Have Always Lived in the Castle
programmes.d: Two sisters live in isolation with their deranged uncle following the deaths of the rest of their family. When a cousin comes to visit, family secrets and scandals unravel. Based on the beloved Shirley Jackson novel.

programmes.t: We Need to Talk About Kevin
programmes.d: Eva is mother to the evil Kevin. She contends with her clueless husband and her son's malevolent ways, in this chilling and unforgettable film.
A college lecturer flees to Paris after a scandal costs him his job. In the City of Light, he meets a widow who might be involved in a series of murders.
This all-female horror anthology features four dark tales from four fiercely talented women.
In the near future, the mysterious arrival of a scientist sets in motion a college professor’s experiment to prove the existence of AI consciousness.
A man with the ability to enter people's memories takes on the case of a brilliant, troubled sixteen-year-old girl to determine whether she is a sociopath or a victim of trauma.
On a quiet suburban street, a babysitter must defend a twelve-year-old boy from intruders, only to discover it's far from a normal home invasion.

A couple take a vacation to a remote island - their last holiday together before they become parents. Soon after their arrival, they notice that no adults seem to be present - an observation that quickly presents a nightmarish reality.
